policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="promptBody" value="@(context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true))" />

        
        
            
                
                    
                    
                        blocklist-match
                    
                    { "error": "Request blocked by enterprise content policy." }
                
            
        

        
        
            @("{{language-endpoint}}language/:analyze-text?api-version={{language-api-version}}")
            POST
            
                application/json
            
            
                {{language-key}}
            
            @{
                var body = (string)context.Variables["promptBody"];
                var payload = new JObject(
                    new JProperty("kind", "PiiEntityRecognition"),
                    new JProperty("parameters", new JObject(
                        new JProperty("redactionPolicy", new JObject(
                            new JProperty("policyKind", "entityMask"))))),
                    new JProperty("analysisInput", new JObject(
                        new JProperty("documents", new JArray(
                            new JObject(
                                new JProperty("id", "1"),
                                new JProperty("language", "en"),
                                new JProperty("text", body))))))
                );
                return payload.ToString();
            }
        

        <set-variable name="redactedText" value="@{
            var r = ((IResponse)context.Variables["piiResp"]).Body.As(preserveContent: true);
            var token = r.SelectToken("results.documents[0].redactedText");
            return token != null ? (string)token : (string)context.Variables["promptBody"];
        }" />

        @{
            var original = JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["promptBody"]);
            var msgs = (JArray)original["messages"];
            if (msgs != null) {
                for (int i = msgs.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    if ((string)msgs[i]["role"] == "user") {
                        msgs[i]["content"] = (string)context.Variables["redactedText"];
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            return original.ToString();
        }

        
        
            
                
                
                
                
            
        

        
        

        
        
            
            
            
            
            
        

        
        
        
        
            @("Bearer " + (string)context.Variables["msi-token"])
